text.title: C# Clean Architecture + CQRS Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. The `aggregates`/`cold_start_budget` branches are the scope gate; the flat `signal ==` branches are a defect router applied to a PR diff once the methodology is in scope.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the domain have ≥3 aggregate roots with non-CRUD business rules?

conclusion.verdict: skip-this-methodology — use `csharp-dotnet` umbrella; Clean Architecture is overhead for shallow CRUD
skip-this-methodology — Minimal API + direct DbContext fits Lambda/Functions; layering adds cold-start cost

branch.question: Does business behaviour live on Domain entities (not handlers)?

conclusion.verdict: move rules from handlers onto entity methods before scaffolding more handlers

branch.question: Are cross-aggregate domain events dispatched inline inside SaveChangesAsync?

conclusion.verdict: install MassTransit Outbox + relay; persist event rows in same transaction
apply remaining rules — one-command-per-folder, FluentValidation on Commands, NetArchTest fitness in CI
adopt aggregate behaviour and layer direction, but skip the mediator — pipeline overhead exceeds its benefit for solo work
project to a response record inside the query handler; one DTO per query
switch to private set + factory method; move the mutation into an intention-revealing method
split into one record request + one handler whose Handle takes a CancellationToken
page and project inside the handler; return materialized DTOs
inject IApplicationDbContext; move transport concerns to the API layer
register behaviours in one explicit block and assert the order in a test
name the library and pin the major in Directory.Packages.props; prefer source-gen Mediator/Mapperly for a commercial product
publish from the SaveChangesAsync override or outbox relay, then clear the aggregate's events
add a WebApplicationFactory + Testcontainers test for the feature

text.example: aggregates=4 → cold_start_budget=high → behaviour_on_entities=true → inline_dispatch=false → apply remaining rules → FluentValidation pipeline + NetArchTest assertions in CI.
